reference_formulation: Direct final lap-time seconds, no median subtraction/addition or baseline feature
input_boundary: Only the original 13 causal feature columns reach model.fit/predict; labels join after feature construction
historical_test_role: Frozen descriptive rows only; excluded before feature diagnostics
source_progress_decision: Car Pos Norm exists; author paper documents normalized spline position. The exact ACTI export mapping/resampling semantics are not independently established. Omit raw normalized-progress F4; a causal integrated ground-speed distance proxy may be evaluated without a track-length normalization.
limitations: Recording blocks and participant codes do not certify independent physical sessions; correlated checkpoints are not independent laps.
